verses.en: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
verses.pt: O vinho é escarnecedor, e a bebida forte alvoroçadora; e todo aquele que neles errar não e sábio.
verses.en_web: Wine is a mocker, and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
verses.en_bbe: Wine makes men foolish, and strong drink makes men come to blows; and whoever comes into error through these is not wise.

verses.en: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
verses.pt: Como o bramido do leão é o terror do rei; quem o provoca a ira peca contra a sua própria vida.
verses.en_web: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.
verses.en_bbe: The wrath of a king is like the loud cry of a lion: he who makes him angry does wrong against himself.

verses.en: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
verses.pt: Honroso é para o homem o desviar-se de questões; mas todo insensato se entremete nelas.
verses.en_web: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife; but every fool will be quarreling.
verses.en_bbe: It is an honour for a man to keep from fighting, but the foolish are ever at war.

verses.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.pt: O preguiçoso não lavra no outono; pelo que mendigará na sega, e nada receberá.
verses.en_web: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.en_bbe: The hater of work will not do his ploughing because of the winter; so at the time of grain-cutting he will be requesting food and will get nothing.

verses.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.pt: Como águas profundas é o propósito no coração do homem; mas o homem inteligente o descobrirá.
verses.en_web: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.en_bbe: The purpose in the heart of a man is like deep water, but a man of good sense will get it out.

verses.en: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
verses.pt: Muitos há que proclamam a sua própria bondade; mas o homem fiel, quem o achará?
verses.en_web: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?
verses.en_bbe: Most men make no secret of their kind acts: but where is a man of good faith to be seen?

verses.en: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
verses.pt: O justo anda na sua integridade; bem-aventurados serão os seus filhos depois dele.
verses.en_web: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.
verses.en_bbe: An upright man goes on in his righteousness: happy are his children after him!

verses.en: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
verses.pt: Assentando-se o rei no trono do juízo, com os seus olhos joeira a todo malfeitor.
verses.en_web: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.
verses.en_bbe: A king on the seat of judging puts to flight all evil with his eyes.

verses.en: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
verses.pt: Quem pode dizer: Purifiquei o meu coração, limpo estou de meu pecado?
verses.en_web: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin?”
verses.en_bbe: Who is able to say, I have made my heart clean, I am free from my sin?

verses.en: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD.
verses.pt: O peso fraudulento e a medida falsa são abominação ao Senhor, tanto uma como outra coisa.
verses.en_web: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Unequal weights and unequal measures, they are all disgusting to the Lord.

verses.en: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
verses.pt: Até a criança se dá a conhecer pelas suas ações, se a sua conduta é pura e reta.
verses.en_web: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.
verses.en_bbe: Even a child may be judged by his doings, if his work is free from sin and if it is right.

verses.en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.
verses.pt: O ouvido que ouve, e o olho que vê, o Senhor os fez a ambos.
verses.en_web: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, Yahweh has made even both of them.
verses.en_bbe: The hearing ear and the seeing eye are equally the Lord's work.

verses.en: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
verses.pt: Não ames o sono, para que não empobreças; abre os teus olhos, e te fartarás de pão.
verses.en_web: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be a lover of sleep, or you will become poor: keep your eyes open, and you will have bread enough.

verses.en: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.pt: Nada vale, nada vale, diz o comprador; mas, depois de retirar-se, então se gaba.
verses.en_web: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
verses.en_bbe: A poor thing, a poor thing, says he who is giving money for goods: but when he has gone on his way, then he makes clear his pride in what he has got.

verses.en: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.pt: Há ouro e abundância de pedras preciosas; mas os lábios do conhecimento são jóia de grande valor.
verses.en_web: There is gold and abundance of rubies; but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.
verses.en_bbe: There is gold and a store of corals: but the lips of knowledge are a jewel of great price.

verses.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.pt: Tira a roupa àquele que fica por fiador do estranho; e toma penhor daquele que se obriga por estrangeiros.
verses.en_web: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
verses.en_bbe: Take a man's clothing if he makes himself responsible for a strange man, and get an undertaking from him who gives his word for strange men.

verses.en: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
verses.pt: Suave é ao homem o pão da mentira; mas depois a sua boca se enche de pedrinhas.
verses.en_web: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
verses.en_bbe: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but after, his mouth will be full of sand.

verses.en: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
verses.pt: Os projetos se confirmam pelos conselhos; assim, pois, com prudencia faze a guerra.
verses.en_web: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!
verses.en_bbe: Every purpose is put into effect by wise help: and by wise guiding make war.

verses.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
verses.pt: O que anda mexericando revela segredos; pelo que não te metas com quem muito abre os seus lábios.
verses.en_web: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
verses.en_bbe: He who goes about talking of the business of others gives away secrets: so have nothing to do with him whose lips are open wide.

verses.en: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
verses.pt: O que amaldiçoa a seu pai ou a sua mãe, apagar-se-lhe-á a sua lâmpada nas, mais densas trevas.
verses.en_web: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
verses.en_bbe: If anyone puts a curse on his father or his mother, his light will be put out in the blackest night.

verses.en: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.pt: A herança que no princípio é adquirida às pressas, não será abençoada no seu fim.
verses.en_web: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning, won’t be blessed in the end.
verses.en_bbe: A heritage may be got quickly at first, but the end of it will not be a blessing.

verses.en: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.
verses.pt: Não digas: vingar-me-ei do mal; espera pelo Senhor e ele te livrará.
verses.en_web: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.
verses.en_bbe: Do not say, I will give punishment for evil: go on waiting for the Lord, and he will be your saviour.

verses.en: Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD; and a false balance is not good.
verses.pt: Pesos fraudulentos são abomináveis ao Senhor; e balanças enganosas não são boas.
verses.en_web: Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.
verses.en_bbe: Unequal weights are disgusting to the Lord, and false scales are not good.

verses.en: Man’s goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
verses.pt: Os passos do homem são dirigidos pelo Senhor; como, pois, poderá o homem entender o seu caminho?
verses.en_web: A man’s steps are from Yahweh; how then can man understand his way?
verses.en_bbe: A man's steps are of the Lord; how then may a man have knowledge of his way?

verses.en: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
verses.pt: Laço é para o homem dizer precipitadamente: É santo; e, feitos os votos, então refletir.
verses.en_web: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.
verses.en_bbe: It is a danger to a man to say without thought, It is holy, and, after taking his oaths, to be questioning if it is necessary to keep them.

verses.en: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
verses.pt: O rei sábio joeira os ímpios e faz girar sobre eles a roda.
verses.en_web: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.
verses.en_bbe: A wise king puts evil-doers to flight, and makes their evil-doing come back on them.

verses.en: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
verses.pt: O espírito do homem é a lâmpada do Senhor, a qual esquadrinha todo o mais íntimo do coração.
verses.en_web: The spirit of man is Yahweh’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord keeps watch over the spirit of man, searching all the deepest parts of the body.

verses.en: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
verses.pt: A benignidade e a verdade guardam o rei; e com a benignidade sustém ele o seu trono.
verses.en_web: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.
verses.en_bbe: Mercy and good faith keep the king safe, and the seat of his power is based on upright acts.

verses.en: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.
verses.pt: A glória dos jovens é a sua força; e a beleza dos velhos são as cãs.
verses.en_web: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.
verses.en_bbe: The glory of young men is their strength, and the honour of old men is their grey hairs.

verses.en: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
verses.pt: Os açoites que ferem purificam do mal; e as feridas penetram até o mais íntimo do corpo.
verses.en_web: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.
verses.en_bbe: By the wounds of the rod evil is taken away, and blows make clean the deepest parts of the body.
